_note: Quest state is runtime data. 'offered' means the party has heard of it, 'active' means they have taken it up, 'complete'/'failed' are terminal.

quests.title: Reach the Keep
quests.notes: Opening arc. The Keep is the only place a long rest works. | The party reached the outer gatehouse alive.

quests.title: Report to the Castellan
quests.reward: The Caves of Chaos quest, and pay
quests.notes: Winvarle briefs the party on the Caves. This is what opens the sandbox.

quests.title: Bandits on the Trail
steps: Deal with Pral and his band
quests.notes: Pral can survive and become a recurring antagonist. Do not force a kill.

quests.title: The Caves of Chaos
steps: Learn what is organising the tribes
quests.reward: Levels (one per cave cleared), treasure, the Keep's gratitude
quests.notes: The main track. Clearing caves is the level-up mechanism. Factions can be allied instead of killed.

quests.title: Something Is Organising Them
steps: Find the iron tome in C3 Library
Or talk to Oggdug about his off-limits caves
Or meet cultists in G6 Cult Barrack
quests.notes: Three independent routes to this reveal. Any one is enough.

quests.title: The Chaos Bell
steps: Learn how the Bell can be destroyed
quests.notes: Endgame. Require the tome (or equivalent knowledge) before letting them attempt it.

quests.title: The Empty Temple
steps: Hear that the temple's priest left
quests.notes: Plant in the Keep, pay off in Cave K. Best delivered by a Keep NPC rumour.
